movie.title: The Wrong Girls
movie.overview: Two codependent best friends living paycheck to paycheck and bong rip to bong rip get caught in a case of mistaken identity that throws their lives into chaos.

reviews.author: tender_buttkiss
reviews.content: This is prime stoner comedy. Absurd premise, crazy antics and lots of good music. Yeah, it's not perfect, but it's everything I want out of a stoner movie featuring Alia Shawkat and Kristen Stewart. Silly and full of hi-jinxes and cats that can also talk! Hell yeah!

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Two codependent, pot-smoking best friends struggle to make ends meet until a wild case of mistaken identity spirals their already chaotic lives out of control.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Living paycheck to paycheck and floating through life on a haze of bong rips, two inseparable best friends share an intense, codependent bond. Their fragile routine is abruptly shattered when they are unexpectedly caught in a chaotic case of mistaken identity. Forced to navigate a series of dangerous and absurd misunderstandings, the duo must rely on their friendship to survive the tailspin. Along the way, they are forced to confront whether their lifestyle is keeping them afloat or holding them back.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Living on the financial edge in a joint pursuit of low-stress survival, two codependent best friends rely heavily on each other and their shared love of weed to get through the day. Their predictable routine of scrambling for rent and getting high takes an unexpected turn when a bizarre misunderstanding thrusts them into the crosshairs of a mix-up intended for two entirely different people. Suddenly embroiled in a situation far bigger and more dangerous than their usual daily struggles, the pair is dragged into a high-stakes series of misadventures across the city. As they attempt to untangle themselves from the mess without getting caught or exposed, their lack of ambition and constant state of intoxication create hilariously bad decisions at every turn. Yet, beneath the chaotic set pieces and comedy of errors, the escalating pressure exposes deep-seated flaws in their dynamic. Forced to make split-second choices to protect one another, they begin to re-evaluate their reliance on bad habits and mutual complacency. Ultimately, the ordeal serves as a wild wake-up call that challenges them to grow up without losing the core loyalty that binds them together. By the time the dust settles, their world is completely transformed, forcing both women to decide what kind of future they actually want.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: The Wrong Girls centers on two inseparable best friends whose lives revolve around surviving the daily grind, dodging adult responsibilities, and sharing bong rips in their modest apartment. Deeply codependent, the pair have created a comfortable bubble that shields them from the realities of adulthood and career ambitions. However, their quiet life of low-stakes chaos is upended when a bizarre case of mistaken identity drags them into a whirlwind of unexpected trouble and erratic characters. Blending laugh-out-loud buddy comedy with grounded dramedy, the story explores the hilarious and touching boundaries of female friendship, codependency, and the painful yet necessary process of growing up.
